newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Five Somali gunmen killed in clash near Mogadishu.
newsitem.headline: Five Somali gunmen killed in clash near Mogadishu.

text.p: Five militiamen were killed when gunmen in battlewagons opened fire on their checkpoint northwest of the Somali capital Mogadishu on Saturday, witnesses said.

They said the five were killed at a checkpoint 13 km (eight miles) northwest of south Mogadishu on the road to the town of Afgoi when the gunmen sprayed them with bullets from machineguns mounted on four-wheel-drives.
Some Mogadishu residents said they believed the attack was in revenge for the killing of a man at the checkpoint this week.
In a separate incident, two men were shot dead when they attempted to hijack a passenger bus in north Mogadishu but were caught by Islamic court militiamen.
Somalia has had no central government since the overthrow of late president Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991. Famine fuelled by bouts of civil war killed an estimated 300,000 people in 1992.
